description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search e-tax invoice monthly statistics. Use wrt_ym_strt/wrt_ym_end in YYYYMM format (e.g. 202507/202509 for July-September 2025). For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

ht_rtn_cd_end.description: Quarter end code (분기 종료 코드, e.g. '20254'). Used only when dt_cl=02(quarterly).

ht_rtn_cd_strt.description: Quarter start code (분기 시작 코드, e.g. '20251'). Used only when dt_cl=02(quarterly).

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.

wrt_ym_end.description: End period, same format as wrt_ym_strt (monthly YYYYMM / quarterly YYYY+quarter / yearly YYYY).

wrt_ym_strt.description: Start period. Monthly(dt_cl=01): YYYYMM (e.g. 202507). Quarterly(02): YYYY+quarter code (e.g. 20251). Yearly(03): YYYY.
